profile.headline: Systems Software Engineer
profile.summary: Specialties: Embedded Systems, Management Apps, Systems Engineering, Virtualization

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed features to enhance private cloud product experience.
    •	Added peer-info headers on service-based interfaces to enable traffic probing.
    •	Provided Azure dashboard support for 3rd party Radio Access Network metrics via Open Telemetry.
    •	Created vendor tools for Subscriber Identity Module provisioning through Azure Marketplace.
positions.insights: Skills: Written Communication · Microsoft Azure · Python (Programming Language) · Go · Go (Programming Language) · Agile Software Development · REST APIs · Azure DevOps Services · Telemetry · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Developed security enhancements for Mobile Content Cloud product.
    •	Refactored existing codebase for compliance with Microsoft secure coding standards.
    •	Developed security enhancements for Mobile Content Cloud product.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Software Development · C++ · Embedded Linux · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managed a team of 7 direct reports locally on virtualized Session Border Controller (SBC).
    •	Coordinated development across geographies to release a virtualized SBC.  Developed additional team of 5 ICs for virtual SBC in India.
    •	Coordinated development of hypervisor awareness for virtualized SBC. Added support for Cloud orchestration in AWS, Azure, and OCI.
    •	Led continuous integration effort to support virtual SBC on latest DPDK.
    •	Coordinated lab inventory and CAPEX management for multiple teams as well as preparing lab equipment for facilities move.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with hardware and mechanical engineers on x86 server development.
    •	Platform lead for management software on new Intel architecture servers with integrated service processor. Led an international team of developers, from bring-up through successful release of product.
    •	Trainer for APAC support team.
    •	Responsible for kernel, driver and cross-compiler toolchain updates for ARM-based service processors
    •	Implemented embedded networking for blade servers that allowed redundant system controllers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the embedded system powering the Perspecta volumetric display. 
•	Created the embedded system software package including BIOS and OS.
•	Established cross-platform nightly build/test system.
•	Performed customer installations
•	Demonstrated product capabilities and features.
•	Enhanced Windows application to support Analyze medical visualization.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Customer Engagement · Product Demonstration · Joint Test Action Group (JTAG) · Embedded Linux · Xilinx · RS232 · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key contributor on Trusted Core pre-boot platform.
•	Created embedded Linux package for advanced BIOS utilities
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platform technical lead supporting VxWorks RTOS for PMC standard processor boards for router fabric modules.
•	Collaborated with Release engineering to simplify BSP upgrades.
•	Integrated proprietary kernel changes with updated VxWorks OS and toolchain.
•	Co-developed Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (AAA) subsystem with TACACS+ and RADIUS support.
•	Ported Open Source SSH to VxWorks avoiding license fees
•	Adapted standard networking utilities (i.e. – FTP, ping, SNTP) to support dual IP stack.
•	Implemented CLI for file systems, ICMP, AAA, SSH, user management, and connection management.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Joint Test Action Group (JTAG) · RS232 · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote drivers under pSOS to control PMC-Sierra SAR device on DS3 connectivity board. Driver received mailbox messages and manipulated registers in the SAR.

Worked with an extensively SNMP based CLI, for the Total Control product. Wrote proprietary MIBs for CLI commands, as well as provided support for standard MIBs in authored drivers.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote Modem auto-configuration software for terminal server that would attempt to identify a modem through table-driven "AT" queries.

Wrote RS-232 DTE/DCE device detection software for the same product. This would manipulate the physical port characteristics in order to determine if the connected device was a modem(DCE) or a terminal(DTE).
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · RS232 · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical support for the Internext product line, handled customer configuration issues and escalating bugs found in the field.

Wrote scripts to test MIB implementations of multiple products in the InterneXt product line.
 
Setup Ethernet & Token-Ring LAN interoperability testing lab, with equipment from multiple manufacturers.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · C (Programming Language)

projects.title: Integrated Lights Out Manager
projects.description: Integrated Lights Out Manager (ILOM) is the service processor embedded on all Sun's SPARC Enterprise T-series and Sun Fire x86 servers, including all rack mounts and blades.
